stories.name: Chicago
stories.text: Straight ahead, about 8 miles: Chicago. Chicago is the most populous city in the state of Illinois. It was incorporated as a city in 1837. The city lies on the southwestern shore of Lake Michigan. That's the story.

stories.name: Field Museum
stories.spatialCue: ahead on your left, about 8 miles
stories.text: Ahead on your left, about 8 miles: Field Museum. The Field Museum is a natural history museum in Chicago. It was founded in 1893. That's the story.

stories.name: Chinatown
stories.text: You're passing through it now: Chinatown, a neighbourhood.

stories.name: Buckingham Fountain
stories.spatialCue: ahead on your right, about 2 miles
stories.text: Ahead on your right, about 2 miles: Buckingham Fountain. Buckingham Fountain is a large fountain in the center of Grant Park. It was dedicated in 1927. That's the story.

stories.name: Art Institute of Chicago
stories.text: Straight ahead, about a mile: Art Institute of Chicago. The Art Institute of Chicago is one of the oldest and largest art museums in the United States. The Modern Wing, designed by Renzo Piano, opened in 2009. It was founded in 1879. Its Beaux-Arts building on Michigan Avenue opened in 1893. The two bronze lions at the Michigan Avenue entrance were sculpted by Edward Kemeys. It connects with Field Museum, which we passed earlier. That's the story.

stories.name: Cloud Gate
stories.spatialCue: ahead on your right, about a mile
stories.text: Ahead on your right, about a mile: Cloud Gate. Cloud Gate is a public sculpture by Anish Kapoor in Millennium Park. It was formally dedicated on May 15, 2006. It is made of 168 stainless steel plates welded together. That's the story.

stories.name: Millennium Park
stories.spatialCue: straight ahead, about a quarter mile
stories.text: Straight ahead, about a quarter mile: Millennium Park. Millennium Park is a public park in the Loop community area of Chicago. It opened on July 16, 2004. It connects with Cloud Gate, which we passed earlier. That's the story.

stories.name: Willis Tower
stories.spatialCue: straight ahead, about half a mile
stories.text: Straight ahead, about half a mile: Willis Tower. Willis Tower, formerly the Sears Tower, is a skyscraper in the Chicago Loop. It was completed in 1973. That's the story.

stories.name: Chicago Cultural Center
stories.spatialCue: straight ahead, about a quarter mile
stories.text: Straight ahead, about a quarter mile: Chicago Cultural Center. The Chicago Cultural Center opened in 1897 as the city's central library. Its Preston Bradley Hall is crowned by a Tiffany glass dome about 38 feet across. It connects with Art Institute of Chicago, which we passed earlier. That's the story.
